# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9

## Reflection
Men, we often wake up with the weight of the world on our shoulders—bills, deadlines, family pressures, and the constant assault of temptation. The enemy wants you to believe you face this day alone. But Joshua stood at the edge of a terrifying unknown, facing fortified cities and giants, and God’s command was not "be smart" or "be prepared"—it was "be strong and courageous." That strength isn’t manufactured by your grit; it’s found in the presence of the One who goes before you. Courage isn’t the absence of fear; it’s the decision to move forward in obedience despite the trembling in your hands. Today, you are not fighting for victory—you are fighting *from* victory. Christ has already secured the win. Your job is to stand firm, take the next step, and trust that the God who parted the Red Sea is walking right beside you in your cubicle, your garage, and your living room. So square your shoulders, fix your eyes on Him, and engage the battle with holy boldness.

## Daily Challenge
Before you start your day, drop down and do 25 pushups—each rep, whisper, "The Lord is with me." Let your body remind your spirit that you are not alone.
